module.clean.label: Clean
clean.title: Clean
clean.description: Fix what is wrong in the data, step by step. Each fix says why; the original is never changed: you save a cleaned version beside it.
clean.isVersion: This is {name}, a cleaned version. Clean always starts from the original.
clean.banner.label: Draft
clean.banner.noSteps: No step yet: tick a suggestion or add a step.
clean.layer.advancedHint: Clusters of spellings, values that depend on another column, units, near-duplicate rows.
clean.layer.advancedBody: These checks take longer and are never applied on their own: they come in the next version of Clean.
clean.layer.expertHint: Slow or niche, run one by one: suspicious labels, cell errors learnt from a few marks, imputation for analysis.
clean.layer.expertBody: Nothing is computed here until you ask: each check will have its own Run button, with progress and a way to stop it. Coming later.
clean.layer.empty: Nothing to fix here: no rule found a problem.
clean.modeHint.A: Lossless and unambiguous: ticked by default.
clean.modeHint.S: Probably right, but check first: not ticked.
clean.steps.label: Steps of the draft
clean.steps.empty: No step yet. Tick a suggestion, or add your own step.
clean.steps.pick: Pick a step to see its settings and what it changes.
clean.steps.off: This step is off: it is kept in the draft but does not run.
clean.catalog.title: Add a step
clean.opHint.drop_columns: Leave columns out of the cleaned version.
clean.opHint.duplicate_column: A copy of a column, beside it.
clean.opHint.change_type: Write a column as numbers, dates, true/false or text, with its format.
clean.opHint.normalize_spaces: Trim the ends, one space between words (tabs, no-break spaces).
clean.opHint.remove_invisible: Zero-width spaces, byte-order marks, control characters.
clean.opHint.change_case: lower case, UPPER CASE or Title Case.
clean.opHint.replace_values: Replace an exact value, a piece of text or a pattern (regular expression).
clean.opHint.map_values: A table old value → new value; also merges spellings.
clean.opHint.fill: Empty cells take the value above (down) or below (up).
clean.opHint.fill_empty: Empty cells take a value you give.
clean.opHint.null_outside: Numbers below a minimum or above a maximum become empty.
clean.opHint.pad_zeros: Codes that lost their leading zeros get them back (5207 → 05207).
clean.opHint.filter_rows: Keep or remove the rows matching conditions.
clean.opHint.drop_duplicates: Rows equal on the chosen columns (all by default): keep one.
clean.opHint.drop_empty_rows: Rows with no value at all.
clean.opHint.drop_header_rows: Rows repeating the column names (files pasted together).
clean.field.formatsHint: strptime formats, separated by commas (%d/%m/%Y, %Y-%m-%d); empty: the usual ones
clean.field.keysHint: Columns, separated by commas; empty: every column
clean.field.why.decimal: The character between the whole part and the decimals.
clean.field.why.excel: Numbers from 20,000 to 60,000 read as Excel day numbers (1899-12-30 + n).
clean.field.why.mapFromRule: Kept from the rule: only these values change, a new value is never merged on its own.
clean.case.title: Title Case
clean.reset.label: Reset to the rule's value
clean.preview.title: What it changes
clean.preview.none: Nothing changes: no value is touched and no row is removed.
clean.preview.first: The first {count} rows touched, before and after
clean.versions.label: Versions of this dataset
clean.versions.none: No cleaned version yet. Save the draft to make Cleaned v1.
clean.versions.name: Cleaned v{seq}
clean.versions.outOfDateHint: The original was reimported or retyped since this version was made.
clean.versions.deleteBody: The cleaned version is removed; the original stays as it is.
clean.family.label: Version of the dataset
clean.settings.title: Cleaning
clean.settings.intro: What Clean does with a new dataset. The original is never changed.
clean.settings.modeHint: Suggest only: suggestions are computed when Clean opens, the lossless ones ticked. Create a cleaned version: Cleaned v1 is made after each new import when a lossless fix changes a cell. Off: nothing is computed until you ask.
